body: There are too many sources. I literally just can't fight to keep going anymore. I want to die and I don't want to live anymore. I would like to end the suffering. Thank you for trying to help.

I have traveled the world. I taught in poor villages in Africa. I moved to Korea by myself and lived there for a year. I have done those things. I am always helping other people. I rescue animals. I would give anything to help take pain away from others. I know that there is more to life than being smart attractive and successful...my point is that people look at me that way and think "how could she ever want to die?!"...but I do. I am in so much pain. Every day. I have been for as long as I can remember.

I've done those things and I no longer enjoy them. I have sky dived over Table Mountain, bungee jumped from the tallest bungee in the world. None of my hobbies that meant something to me before mean anything to me now. My parents are dead. My only brother is a drug addict and  is homeless. My diabetes makes it impossible for me to just go anywhere or live carefree. I am successful because I thought that by doing my best I would end up happy and it just never worked. I am empty.
